newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: "Mummified" body of U.S. citizen found.
newsitem.headline: "Mummified" body of U.S. citizen found.

text.p: The body of a Polish-born U.S. citizen, apparently murdered months ago during a burglary, was found in a mummified condition in his suburban San Jose home on Monday, a police spokewoman said on Wednesday.

Matthew Bajan, 72, a retired civil engineer from San Diego, California, lost so much bodily fluid after apparently falling victim to a robber that his body did not decompose, judicial police spokeswoman Margarita Morales told Reuters.
Police found Bajan's remains on his bedroom floor after a friend, who last saw Bajan in December, reported him missing, she said.
"The body was totally mummified," Morales said. "It did not give an odour that would have alerted neighbours."
Determination of the exact time and cause of death will await an autopsy that will be completed this week, Morales said.
Police found a chair in the bathroom below a hole in the roof through which the intruder apparently entered. A television and videotape player were missing, she said.
